evidence: Modifies src/node/mempool_args.cpp and adds tests in src/test/mempool_tests.cpp to validate limits such as -limitclustersize, -mempoolexpiry, and -datacarriersize.
rationale: Prevents invalid or negative mempool configuration values from causing logic inversions or bypassing datacarrier limits. This is marginal within mempool because it affects startup argument validation rather than core mempool policy, eviction, or data structures.
